title: NLSM amplitudes from a quartic two-derivative theory
summary: We revisit the well-known nonlinear sigma model (NLSM), an effective field theory describing the scattering of $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ Goldstone bosons and characterized by an infinite tower of two-derivative interactions. We introduce a local scalar Lagrangian involving two scalar fields $ψ^\pm$ carrying opposite "polarities", whose interacting part consists of a single polynomial quartic two-derivative operator, and prove that it reproduces planar NLSM amplitudes at all loop orders. This quartic two-derivative formulation reveals a previously hidden simplicity of the NLSM: its Feynman rules…
